title: Agentforce AI Assistant for Self-Service Portal and Service Management
description: The system must provide an Agentforce AI Assistant accessible from the self-service portal and service management interface, enabling requestors to receive conversational assistance, raise and manage tickets without navigating forms, and enabling fulfillers to receive proactive AI-powered recommendations on incident records.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-0006: Agentforce AI Assistant is visible and accessible when the portal page loads
AC-0007: The assistant identifies user intent from natural language input
AC-0008: The assistant retrieves answers from relevant knowledge articles
AC-0009: The assistant gathers required information and creates incidents after user confirmation
AC-0010: Issues are correctly classified as Incidents or Service Requests
AC-0011: Users can view and inquire about their existing ticket status
AC-0012: Users can add information to existing tickets through the assistant
AC-0013: Tickets created by Agentforce are marked with Source = Agentforce
AC-0014: Classification fields are auto-populated from conversation data
AC-0015: Tickets are auto-routed to the correct resolver team
AC-0016: Authorized fulfillers can access Proactive Assistance on the Incident page
nonFunctionalRequirements: Assistant response time < 3 seconds for conversational interactions
Incident creation completes within 5 seconds of user confirmation
Supports concurrent user sessions without degradation
Conversation context maintained across multi-turn interactions
Agent availability SLA aligned with portal SLA
author: Test Design Agent
